rationale: A run needs an explicit requested model selector. It is a stable, user-meaningful input to planning and remains distinct from deployment identity, agent identity, and any later observed provider model revision.
alternatives: derive from deployment: would hide a material run input and couple the plan to deployment internals
rename to model_id: adds no distinction because this field is a provider model selector, not necessarily a durable provider-assigned ID
replace with model_revision: conflates the requested model with a revision that may not be observable until execution
simplestChoice: Keep `model` as the required requested model selector; record any provider-observed revision separately in execution receipts/status.
